name: CoreSignal
keyHint: Find it in your CoreSignal dashboard under API keys.
costNote: CoreSignal charges nothing until you run a request.
briefs: Track new job posts weekly
Look up one company by website
Find companies like a list I have

name: Open-Meteo
costNote: Open-Meteo is free for non-commercial use and needs no key.
briefs: Daily forecast for a list of cities
Rain and temperature for the next week
Past weather for one place and date range

name: Hacker News search
costNote: Hacker News search by Algolia is free and needs no key.
briefs: AI launch posts with at least 50 points in the last day
New Show HN posts about a topic
Comments that mention my product

name: Google Places
keyHint: Find it in the Google Cloud console under APIs and services, then Credentials.
costNote: Google bills each Places request to your Cloud account.
briefs: Cafes within 2 km of an address
Details for a list of businesses
New places of one type in a city

name: REST Countries
costNote: REST Countries is free and needs no key.
briefs: Every country in a region
Countries that use one currency
Capital and population for a list

name: Nominatim
costNote: Nominatim is free, with a limit of one request a second.
briefs: Coordinates for a list of addresses
The address at a point
Places that match a name in one country

name: NASA APIs
topic: space images, asteroids and Earth data
keyHint: Get one free at api.nasa.gov with your email.
costNote: NASA’s APIs are free with a key.
briefs: Asteroids passing Earth this week
Picture of the day for a date range
Mars rover photos from one day

name: OpenWeather
keyHint: Find it in your OpenWeather account under API keys.
costNote: OpenWeather’s free plan covers a set number of calls a day.
briefs: Current weather for a list of cities
Five-day forecast for one place
Air quality at a point
